notes.title: Beta 0.717
notes.notes:
This is a small patch: a few bugs have been fixed, the tracks have been improved, and lap time has been added to single-player mode.

Currently, I'm polishing a new track (it should be ready next week), and I'm working on a refresh of the UI. I’ve also built a preliminary model for the AI, which will likely take a bit more time.

notes.title: Beta 0.715
notes.notes:
As promised, I added a new track named Detroit. It's not 100% optimized yet and may take a few seconds to load, but it's fun to play. I'll polish it over the next few days.

- I also fixed a major bug with the controller (thanks, Red!).
- A minor bug that sometimes caused the camera to be slow has also been addressed.

notes.title: First Patch! Build Beta 0.713
notes.notes:
First patch released 6 hours after launch!
I caught a small bug in the track selection and quickly fixed it.

I'm planning to update the game once a week. Right now, my main focus is on releasing three new tracks that I'm currently testing. I'm also working on a proper single-player mode, including a time attack feature to add more challenge.

I'm still recruiting testers for the experimental (alpha) version of upcoming patches. If you're interested, feel free to reach out via the website — or better yet, on Discord.

Let’s make this the start of a long journey to help the game shine, with your support!
